# TidyFactor GitHub Philosophy

<!-- last-verified: 2026-08-29 -->

> **Notice**: This file contains high-level brand philosophy for human maintainers. It is NOT loaded into operational agent prompts during runtime task execution (Rule 5: Philosophy Isolation).

---

## 1. Repositories as Software Products
A GitHub repository is not a digital storage locker for Git snapshots; it is the front store, documentation desk, security gate, and developer experience portal of your software product. Every repository deserves the same design craft, architectural rigor, and governance clarity as the application code itself.

## 2. Zero Marketing Slop
Developers respect evidence, clean code samples, precise architecture diagrams, and reproducible quick-start commands. We eliminate hype, exaggerated claims, and meaningless buzzwords in favor of crisp technical communication.

## 3. Deterministic Safety & Least Privilege
Security is not an afterthought added before release; it is the foundation of organizational architecture. We enforce least privilege by default, pin third-party actions to immutable commit SHAs, and guard against accidental destructive actions through explicit confirmation gates.
